name: Ba Chua Xu Temple
nameVi: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ Núi Sam
kicker: Pilgrimage hall at the foot of Núi Sam
summary: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ is the hall at the foot of Núi Sam, in phường Vĩnh Tế. You come for the offerings on the steps and the statue inside. Vietnam Tourism says the statue was found on the mountain about 200 years ago. The present temple began in the early 19th century. Arrive early. Midday in the fourth lunar month is the crowd, not a quiet hall.
timeNeeded: Under an hour outside festival days
getThere: Same road as Sam Mountain, about 5 km or about 7 km from town.
heroCaption: The green-roofed hall of Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ at the foot of Núi Sam

notice.title: The fourth lunar month is not a quiet visit
notice.body: TITC says the heaviest days run from the first lunar month to the Via festival. UNESCO places the festival on the 22nd to the 27th of the fourth lunar month. TITC prints the 23rd to the 27th. Come early, or come outside that window.

body: Stand on the steps and watch what people bring: whole pigs, roast chickens, fruit, rice cakes, and pink lotus, with incense in front of the statue inside. Vietnam Tourism says that statue is said to have been found on the mountain about 200 years ago. TITC says the present temple sits at the foot of Núi Sam and began in the early 19th century as a bamboo-and-leaf shrine, later rebuilt with curved southern roofs.

This is the heart of the national tourism area, and the place the 2026 festival opened. The lunar festival, with its palanquin and bathing rite, is a separate page. On an ordinary morning the visit is the hall and the steps. A quiet-day length was not printed. Allow under an hour and leave time for Tây An and the tomb on the same walk.
A fee was not on the UNESCO page or the culture-department article. Check on arrival if a gate asks. Do not look for this shrine in the town market. TITC places it at the mountain.

gettingThere: The temple is at the foot of Núi Sam, phường Vĩnh Tế. Use the same road as the rest of the hill. An older national-tourism article prints both about 5 km and about 7 km from the city. Minutes are check on arrival.
